algorithm: Within each source subclass, sort SHA256(seed|subclass|species_taxid); first floor(n/2) development, remainder independent confirmation.
authorization: User on 2026-09-06 explicitly requested utilization of original Final Test and a better replacement for v0.50 within 12 hours.

gates.label_semantics: All Euk nuclear and organelle positive; Bacteria/Archaea negative.

limitations: Species-disjoint does not imply genus-disjoint or sequence-homology-disjoint.
Original genome-set alignment QC was deferred.
Any prior exposure of the original Final to model development must be audited before calling confirmation untouched.

roles.confirmation: Must not be used for training, tuning or candidate selection. Open sequence/score evaluation only after candidate and threshold freeze; compare the candidate and v0.50 on the same samples. Do not iterate against confirmation results.
roles.development: May be used for training, tuning, error analysis and candidate selection; permanently loses independent-test status once used.
